zh: 总经理首页“各部门进展”改为各部门颜色的彩色卡片，需要处理的数字用白底红字突出
去掉所有广告语；财务和首页的金额数字去掉货币符号（单位统一标在旁边），字号自动缩放，手机上能完整显示
实时自动同步：其他人的修改约 1 秒内出现，不再需要“立即同步”
登录：先选部门，再选职位（后台新增的职位会自动出现），最后输入密码
运费价格增加计费单位（每公斤 / 每立方米 / 每吨），按重量或体积 × 单价自动算出运费，并可试算；登记物流时填重量、体积自动算运费
去掉“本机演示模式”等无用显示
en: GM home: department progress cards now use each department’s colour; items needing attention are highlighted
Removed all slogans; amount tiles drop the currency symbol (unit shown alongside) and shrink to fit on phones
Real-time sync: other people’s changes appear within about a second; no more “Sync now”
Sign in: choose the department, then the position (positions added in the backend appear automatically), then the password
Freight rates now have a unit (per kg / m³ / ton); freight = weight or volume × price, with a calculator; shipments calculate freight from weight and volume
Removed “local demo mode” and other unneeded labels
